title: Feature request: Show BG and arrow on phone unlock screen
symptom: Users want to see blood glucose (BG) and trend arrow on the phone's unlock screen without unlocking the device, similar to a feature in xDrip. The request is for BYODA users who do not use xDrip.
evidence_quote: xDrip has a nice feature, show BG and arrow on the unlock screen of phone. You just wake up the screen to see your BG. It would be nice for BYODA users if AAPS had something similar.
